subject: E-1285: quota exceeded on macOS
body:
Hi, I'm using SyncVault 4.2.8 on macOS 15.3. Since this morning, each time I
start a sync, I get 'E-1285: storage quota exceeded'.

On this machine the cache directory is now many gigabytes large. Our real data is
far smaller than the cache.

What I tried so far: waiting a day. No luck.

Fatima Zahra -- Meridian Schools. Appreciate any hints.
